newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soyoil futures fall sharply in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soyoil futures fall sharply in thin trade.

text.p: CBOT soyoil futures fell sharply in thin trade as funds sold, pit sources said.
"Prudential sold 400 (lots) December into a thin market," a trader said. "That took it down fast."
"There's just no one in there," another trader said. "It's so thin in there you can see right through the pit."

Traders said activity was subdued ahead of a critical weather weekend. The market expected Monday's trade to be volatile with a limit-up move likely if there were no rains this weekend in the central U.S. Midwest. But the market could go limit down if the rains hit, they said.
At 1134 CDT, soyoil was down 0.45 to 0.10 cent per lb with December down 0.45 at 22.62 cents.
